# Ontario Furnace Rebates

> Ontario Furnace Rebates is an independent information and inquiry website for Ontario homeowners planning furnace and hybrid quote review.

- [Ontario furnace replacement: check the rebate claim first | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/): Learn why a standalone gas furnace is not an HRS heat pump rebate and compare repair, replacement and hybrid options.
- [How to compare a furnace quote with a hybrid option | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/how-it-works/): A decision process for furnace repair, replacement or heat pump conversion before accepting a quote.
- [Which furnace-related projects may use heat pump rebates? | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/who-qualifies/): Separate furnace-only work, compatible backup heating and eligible HRS heat pump projects.
- [Check heat pump caps, then compare the furnace budget | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebate-calculator/): This checker covers heat pump caps and does not assign a rebate to a standalone furnace.
- [Send a furnace or hybrid quote question | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/contact/): Ask about a furnace quote, existing equipment and any heat pump rebate line.
- [Furnace quotes and Ontario incentive programs | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebates-explained/): Which incentive claims belong in a furnace quote, what needs a heat pump and what is closed.
- [Furnace and hybrid quote questions | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/faq/): Answers about furnace-only rebates, existing furnaces, emergency replacement and quote comparisons.
- [Why this guide starts with the furnace quote | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/about/): An independent guide for Ontario homeowners comparing furnace replacement and heat pump options.

- [Before replacing an oil furnace, check Ontario support | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebates/oil-to-heat-pump-affordability/): Ontario oil-heated households may have an official no-cost heat pump installation route.
- [Check old Enbridge rebate claims on a new furnace quote | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebates/enbridge-home-efficiency-rebate/): Identify outdated rebate references and ask for the current terms supporting a furnace sales offer.
- [Do not budget a new furnace project around the closed federal loan | Ontario Furnace Rebates](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebates/canada-greener-homes-loan/): New Canada Greener Homes Loan applications closed October 1, 2025.
